## Work experience (most recent first)

  Built full-stack video recording web portal and React Native mobile app. Stack: Next.js, React Native, Docker.

- **Full Stack Engineer Intern** at Cognizant (Feb 2026 – May 2026)
  Developed insurance underwriting system with Angular frontend and C# / .NET microservices with RBAC.

  Developed company website and AI chat mobile application. Stack: React.js, React Native.

## Featured projects

- **ShareVault** — Secure file and text sharing via 6-digit codes. Stack: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Cloudflare R2. Live: https://share-vault-mango.vercel.app/ Code: https://github.com/nikhil-nandanwar/ShareVault

- **GeminiChat** — AI chat interface powered by Google Gemini with streaming, persistent threads, and shareable conversations. Stack: React, Node.js. Live: https://ai-by-gemini.netlify.app/ Code: https://github.com/nikhil-nandanwar/GeminiApp

- **Mines Game** — Modern Minesweeper game with adjustable difficulty and high-contrast accessibility. Stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript. Live: https://mines-game.netlify.app/ Code: https://github.com/nikhil-nandanwar/Mines
